Rain fell steadily against the observation post through the night shift.

Weeks passed as field notes slowly piled up.

Routine maintenance kept the equipment running each season.

Staff rotated through the outpost according to a fixed schedule.

A truck delivered supplies along the gravel road.

Briefings each morning and evening covered weather, staffing, maintenance, and supplies.

The generator kept running without incident through most of the term.

By 1987 the station had logged its coldest reading on record.

Surveyors originally established the boundary marker[^1].
